I hired a package of four baths for my dog ​​for the second time. Before finalizing the package, I made it very clear that he cannot be bathed at short intervals due to veterinary advice, since he has fur and undercoat. I explained that he is bathed every 45 to 60 days, and I was informed that there would be no problem regarding the validity period of the package.
Even so, after the second bath they started demanding an expiration date. Yesterday I scheduled the third bath via WhatsApp, the attendant scheduled it, and then sent the confirmation. Today, I went to the location at the scheduled time, and upon arrival, they said they would need to "check with the owner" if I could still use the package, even though I had paid for two baths.
I waited and, after 15 minutes, they simply said that my package had expired. I went home with the dog without a bath and without a solution.
In addition to a lack of ethics and failure to comply with the agreement, the team is extremely disorganized.

I've known the owners for 3 years and the groomer, Tawani, is excellent.
However, today is the second time I've come here and the receptionist comes with a strong deodorizer. Date 07/19/25
It causes me nausea, headaches, and a severe case of rhinitis.
I feel like the receptionist is bothered when I'm waiting for my pets to be bathed.
I just think they should use this deodorizer when there's no one in the waiting room.
Another thing, they should look into this because some pets are allergic, and this might not be good for them.
This has never happened here before, and with this change in staff, they should look into it.
Unfortunately, this happened for the second time.
Having to leave with headaches, nausea, and a severe case of rhinitis is something nobody deserves.
Not to mention that they charge extra.
Bath one price + 30 for hydration + 30 for hygienic grooming.

It should already have a value to be charged with or without this.
The groomer leaves to come and resolve something that the receptionist doesn't know about?
Hey, come on, the receptionist has to be aware of the store's affairs without having to bother the groomer for that.
Then the groomer left and left the pet on the table with the leash, and what if something happens?
Because that's how accidents with pets on the table happen.
This didn't really happen here.
The owners were always here to see these things.
I found everything I needed for my kittens. The service is very friendly, the prices are good, and it's easy to get around, including parking.

Today, December 31st, I tried calling to find out if they had time for a bath. No one answered! I sent a WhatsApp message, and besides taking a long time to respond, they asked for a photo of my dog, and I asked why? It was to give the price. I have a Shih Tzu, and they charged R$ 90.00… approximately!!!
… I thought it was absurd! On Google, the hours are until 6 PM, and on WhatsApp, they told me they close at 4 PM. Based on the reviews, I thought it would be worth checking out… but based on the service and price… I'll stay far away!!
